separator.description: Path separator for type: hierarchy, e.g. '>'

sorted.description: Only present for type: range -- every (value, doc) pair sorted ascending by value, so an arbitrary min/max filter can be resolved directly against it (docs/guides/facets.md#facet-index-structure). For a range shard, 'values' holds 5 equal-width aggregate buckets computed over the corpus's observed [min, max], keyed by a label like "10-20" or "80+" for the open-ended last bucket.

points.description: Only present for type: geo -- one (lat, lon, doc) coordinate per document declared with searchable-facet-geo-<field>, unsorted (unlike 'sorted' for range, a radius filter has no single-axis ordering to exploit, so this is a plain scan list). 'values' is always {} for a geo shard -- there are no discrete facet values or precomputed aggregate buckets, only radius filtering (docs/guides/facets.md#geo-facets).
